response.rationale: Most of the 16 cited items, including Schepens 2013, Chiswick 2005 and the cognate-recognition studies, link L1-L2 linguistic or lexical similarity to easier learning or better proficiency, with no negative evidence; but several are about general linguistic distance rather than lexical proximity specifically, some measure recognition or guessing rather than proficiency, and Llama 2010 (L2 status over typology, for VOT) is a mild caveat.
